item.title: Counter dharma
item.description: Very late pAshupatas who were already at the margins of their own sect. (pāñcārthika pāśupatas were definitely heterodox in their attitude towards deva and pitR karma. But not in matters of varNa. In fact, their order only admitted V1s and some V2s.)
